## What's new in v2.0.45

### New: expand all menu sections
A new switch under *System → UniWRT Theme → Appearance*: **Expand all menu sections**. When it's on, every section of the side menu (Status, System, Network, Services, …) starts opened up, instead of only the section of the page you're on. You can still fold a section by clicking it, and the current section stays highlighted.

It's off by default, so nothing changes unless you turn it on.

### Upgrading
Run the install line below again (standalone), or install the new package, then reload the page.
